I thought I'd share a review here since reading other reviews is what led me to choose this place versus going to an international hospital in the area. We were vacationing in Thailand when my 6 year old started to develop a very worrisome facial rash as well as a host of other strange, seemingly unrelated symptoms. I decided to go here due to reviews and was seen immediately. The doctor spoke good English, was very professional and immediately understood what was going on and how all the symptoms were linked. After a 20 minute visit, we left with medicine, and she immediately started to get better. The price was very affordable, about 39$ for doctor fee and antibiotics. For a child specific concern, I would highly recommend. For tourists, remember to bring your passport. No appintment necessary, you can walk in.
